of.title: BS/MA Biochemistry: Integrated Program

of.text: Admission to the integrated Bachelor of Science (BS) and Master of Arts in Biochemistry is open only to undergraduate students within The University of Texas at Austin. It results in the awarding of a Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry followed by the Master of Arts in Biochemistry (BS/MA). The integrated program requires completion of a total of 150 credits: 120 hours for the undergraduate degree program and 30 hours of graduate coursework. Students can complete the integrated program in six academic years of full-time study.
